name: frontend-dependency-docs
body: README.md (and the pipeline section of AGENTS.md) documents the frontend dependency contract. After 0.17.0 the set is seven per-language frontends (`apg-go`, `apg-java`, `apg-cpp`, `apg-rust`, `apg-ts`, `apg-csharp`, `apg-py`) plus the bundled structural scanner; Markdown moves into the base and `apg-md` retires. The docs must: name all seven frontend formulae and the bundled structural scanner; cover each scanner's sources (including `src/structlib` absorbing `src/mdlib`); state the scan-time dependencies per frontend; and describe the base build accurately (links a prebuilt static `liblbug` and `openssl@3`, no `cmake`/bundled LadybugDB). Acceptance: a reader can determine, per frontend and for the bundled structural scanner, the build-time deps, the scan-time deps, and the engine pin from README.md; the intro/Features language lists and the project layout cover the seven frontends, the bundled scanner, and their sources (including `src/structlib` and the retired `src/mdlib`).
